title: Palak Paneer
subtitle: Indian spinach and cheese curry
description: Cubes of paneer simmered in a smooth, bright green spinach sauce with cumin, coriander, ginger and chilli. The spinach is cooked with baking soda to keep its colour. Feta or tofu can replace the paneer.

steps.text: Heat a large pot of water with the baking soda. Add the roughly chopped spinach, bring to the boil and cook for 10 minutes until bright green.
Drain and blend in a food processor to a smooth, thick puree.

Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the finely chopped onion for 2-3 minutes until translucent and soft. Add the spices, garlic, ginger and chilli and fry for another 2-3 minutes until the spices become fragrant. Add the spinach puree and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the water and bring to the boil. Add the butter and cream and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat until the sauce thickens slightly.
Just before serving, add the paneer cubes to the hot sauce and cook for 5 minutes so they absorb the flavours. Serve hot.
